text:
suki: quick async standup — model onboarding + evals (short)
- yesterday: finished adapter + quant pipeline for cv-reranker (4-bit qint), ran a small smoke eval on gold80. basic perf looks ok but we hit weird truncation on long captions.
- blockers: prefix cache is getting invalidated for some requests when seq_len > 512, not sure if it's a runtime kv-shape bug or a batching edge-case. observed ~10% regression on recall@5 for a subset.
- today: triage cache invalidation, re-run eval on full gold set (80 -> 800) with logs, push promptset v3-rewrite to PR for review.

matt: re: PR — pinged you on the diff, saw `kv_cache::reset_on_shape_change` toggled off; can you add a short comment about why? hard to follow in the commit. also can we add a repro that uses `make repro-cv`?

suki: yes will add the comment, and adding repro now. repro command I used: `./tools/run_repro --case long_caption_02 --model cv-reranker-q4`

anya: quick thought — some of the long captions are encoded with trailing nulls from preprocessing. could the tokenization length be off? i pushed a tiny preprocess check to `data/cleaners/fix_trailing_nulls.py`. if you want, i can run it against the gold80 and re-run the eval.

suki: thanks @anya — please do that first, saves a roundtrip. if that fixes it, we can skip a runtime change.

geoff: minor: the eval-bot posted a low-level warning yesterday about `quant_scale` mismatch. not sure if related but worth checking the quant metadata for the model variant.

eval-bot: eval run finished (partial): model=cv-reranker-q4, promptset=gold80_v3, size=80 -> recall@5=0.72 (baseline 0.80), latency p50=48ms, warnings=2 (quant_scale_mismatch, kv-shape-warning). full log: https://ci.redwood/models/cv-reranker-q4/runs/1842102400/logs

suki: plan: 1) @anya run the cleaner + re-eval on 80, 2) i add repro and comment in PR, 3) if still broken i'll instrument KV shapes in runtime and run a joined session. will update thread with results.

matt: i'll review the PR after you add the repro and comment. if you want faster turnaround i'm around after 10:30 PT. :thumbsup:

suki: awesome, thanks all — i'll post results in here once cleaner/eval complete.
__notes: single-thread Slack async standup; messages are short and in chronological order
